business_problem: Cropin needed to centralize very large agricultural data streams, reduce infrastructure cost, and speed both analytics delivery and model-training cycles as it expanded OrbitAI across hundreds of crops and global farming workflows.
solution_summary: Cropin rebuilt its agricultural intelligence stack on Google Cloud to connect planetary-scale data, real-time analytics, and agentic AI. BigQuery became the real-time warehouse for more than 670 million agricultural observations, while OrbitAI was launched on Google Cloud using Gemini models and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to support an agentic workforce. Behind the scenes, Google Earth Engine and WeatherNext feed environmental and satellite context into the platform, while Google Kubernetes Engine and Cloud SQL keep the service available globally. Apigee helps manage integrations at the API layer. This unified architecture cut infrastructure cost, reduced BI turnaround from days to seconds, and shortened model-training cycles, letting a relatively small technical team deliver much more output without having to manage multiple disjointed data and ML environments.
